name: Microsoft Word
what_is_it: A desktop word processor for creating, formatting and editing text documents.
used_for: Writing and formatting documents — letters, reports, essays, resumes — with rich text styling, paragraph layout, lists, styles, tables, graphics, headers/footers and review tools.
who_uses: Students, office workers, writers, and virtually anyone producing formatted text documents.

feature_inventory.name: Clipboard
feature_inventory.one_liner: Move and duplicate content and formatting via the clipboard.

feature_inventory.name: Font
feature_inventory.one_liner: Format the characters of the selected text — typeface, size, weight, color, effects.

feature_inventory.name: Paragraph
feature_inventory.one_liner: Format whole paragraphs — lists, indentation, alignment, spacing, shading, borders.

feature_inventory.name: Styles
feature_inventory.one_liner: Apply named, reusable style sets that bundle character and paragraph formatting.

feature_inventory.name: Editing
feature_inventory.one_liner: Find, replace and select text within the document.

feature_inventory.name: Voice
feature_inventory.one_liner: Dictate text by voice using cloud speech recognition.

feature_inventory.name: Editor
feature_inventory.one_liner: Check spelling, grammar and writing refinements via the cloud Editor service.

feature_inventory.name: Adobe Acrobat
feature_inventory.one_liner: Create a PDF from the document via the Adobe Acrobat add-in.

feature_inventory.name: Add-ins
feature_inventory.one_liner: Browse and launch Office Add-ins from the store.

feature_inventory.name: Pages
feature_inventory.one_liner: Insert page-level structure: preformatted cover pages, blank pages, and page breaks.

feature_inventory.name: Tables
feature_inventory.one_liner: Insert tables to organize content in rows and columns; a selected table brings up its own Table Design and Table Layout contextual tabs.

feature_inventory.name: Illustrations
feature_inventory.one_liner: Insert graphic objects — pictures, shapes, icons, 3D models, SmartArt diagrams, charts and screenshots; each selected object surfaces its own Format contextual tab(s).

feature_inventory.name: Media
feature_inventory.one_liner: Embed online videos into the document from web sources.

feature_inventory.name: Links
feature_inventory.one_liner: Create navigation targets and jumps: hyperlinks, bookmarks and cross-references.

feature_inventory.name: Comments
feature_inventory.one_liner: Attach review comments to document ranges for collaboration.

feature_inventory.name: Header & Footer
feature_inventory.one_liner: Repeat content at the top/bottom of every page and number the pages; editing them activates the Header & Footer contextual tab.

feature_inventory.name: Text
feature_inventory.one_liner: Insert text objects and building blocks: text boxes, Quick Parts/fields, WordArt, drop caps, signature lines, date/time and embedded objects.

feature_inventory.name: Symbols
feature_inventory.one_liner: Insert mathematical equations (with the Equation contextual tab) and special symbols not on the keyboard.

feature_inventory.name: eSignature
feature_inventory.one_liner: Request electronic signatures on the document via the SharePoint Syntex cloud service.
